summary: American record producer Phil Spector built the Wall of Sound in the 1960s, held his wife Ronnie captive in their Los Angeles mansion, menaced musicians with guns for decades, and was convicted in 2009 of murdering actress Lana Clarkson.

dies of COVID complications in prison, January 2021

notes: Main span runs from the 1958 Teddy Bears hit to the 2009 conviction; the lifetime rule extends covered years to 1939-2021. Ronnie's later comeback is a short coda, so it does not extend the span. Child-abuse is a few minutes on his adopted children; policing-incarceration covers the investigation and two trials. No theme for gun menace by an individual.
